subject: Upcoming Trip Details
body: Dear valued customer, Thank you for booking your upcoming trip with us. We are excited to provide you with the following details: Departure: May 15th, 2022 at 8:00 AM, Arrival: May 20th, 2022 at 7:00 PM.
